categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies src/span.h to add compile-time lifetime annotations to core span utility functions
categories.rationale: Adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan to diagnose dangling views from temporary containers. Per the description, this prevents developers from 'accidentally bind[ing] views to temporary owning objects that immediately dangle without any compiler warnings.' It improves compile-time safety across shared utilities, but is reasonably deferrable internal hygiene.

categories.rationale: The PR does not substantively alter validation code or invariants. The addition to src/dbwrapper.cpp is a mechanical trait specialization following from the span concept change.
